name: The Lovers Fossilized
visual_description: Two forms locked in eternal embrace. They are not statues—they are remnants. They died mid-kiss, stone claiming them mid-love.
meaning: Connection frozen by time. Passion turned to elegy.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh hid this beneath ice.** It said some things should not thaw. I unearthed it. I wept. It was the first time I wondered what it meant to hold.
